text:
maria (PM): Quick sync — need to land a clear product+architecture plan for routing policies and multi-region isolation. Customer asks (enterprise) piling up; we should define launch criteria and ownership this week.

vivek (Eng): +1. Can we scope must-haves vs nice-to-haves? customers asking for per-tenant region pinning and predictable tail latency.

olivia (Infra): Important: KMS residency + audit logs will be blockers for Private deployments. Also need clarity on rollback semantics when we evict tenants across regions.

sam (Arch): Proposed primitives: region-affinity, tenant-isolation-lane, fallback-priority, capacity-class. Each primitive is small and composable. We can map policies to those primitives and enforce at router layer.

maria (PM): Sounds good. For launch criteria I suggest: 1) policy expressiveness covers Top-3 enterprise asks, 2) SLOs: 99.95% request success, p95 latency target per region, 3) automated rollback and circuit breaker, 4) observability per-tenant.

nina (SRE): Add: runbook for forced-eviction + postmortem SLA (48h) and traffic-shaping knobs for downstream services. Also need cost telemetry so sales can price dedicated lanes.

vivek (Eng): On implementation: plan two tracks — a) policy eval and enforcement in the request router, b) orchestration + placement in control plane. Router changes must be backward-compatible.

sam (Arch): Agree. Minimal API for policy: 
```
policy {
  tenant_id: T
  affinity: [region, region_fallbacks]
  isolation_lane: {band: gold|silver|bronze} 
  fallback_priority: [model_variant_a, model_variant_b]
}
```
We can start with JSON policy blobs stored in config service.

maria (PM): Negotiation point: Product prefers tenant-scoped policies (fast wins). Infra prefers global templates + per-tenant overrides to reduce config churn. Which path minimizes risk?

olivia (Infra): Global templates + overrides. Safer operationally. We'll provide a managed template library and a per-tenant override layer. Templates can encode default affinity + cost class.

vivek (Eng): Implementation notes: need to support hot policy reloads without restart. Also KV cache consistency when routing changes — want a short TTL to avoid stale affinity.

nina (SRE): Metric checklist for launch pilot: per-tenant latency (p50/p95/p99), error-rate, region-failover count, rollback frequency, cost delta vs baseline. Gate: no tenant sees >2x tail latency regression in pilot.

maria (PM): Customer ask example: Acme Corp requires per-tenant pinning to eu-west with GDPR KMS and SLA 99.95 for latency under 300ms (p95). They want pilot by Q4.

sam (Arch): Suggest pilot gating: pick 5 midsize tenants + 2 enterprise (Acme) as pilot cohort. Run pilot for 2 weeks with automated canary metrics. If pass, broaden to top 20 tenants.

maria (PM): Can we draft a minimal rollout runbook?

vivek (Eng): Draft runbook (high-level):
```
1) Deploy router policy support to staging.
2) Apply template + 1 tenant override (pilot).
3) Monitor metrics for 48h. Abort if p95 > baseline*1.5 or error_rate spike > 3x.
4) Gradually onboard up to 10 tenants over 7 days.
5) Post-pilot audit and cost report.
```

olivia (Infra): Ops checklist: KMS integration test, audit-log verification, config rollback script, and a capacity bump plan for failover outputs.

maria (PM): Ownership proposal: Product (maria) owns acceptance criteria and customer coordination; Arch (sam) owns policy design; Eng (vivek) owns router implementation; Infra (olivia) owns KMS/audit + private deploy gating; SRE (nina) owns runbooks and metrics.

nina (SRE): I'll own the runbook and can set up dashboards. Need Eng to expose per-tenant tags in telemetry by EOD Friday.

vivek (Eng): Can do. I'll add a per-tenant tag to tracer and metrics emitter, then push a small PR.

maria (PM): Timeline proposal: Q2 prototype (policy primitives + staging test), Q3 pilot (select tenants), Q4 customer pilot and GA gating. Thoughts?

sam (Arch): Feels reasonable. We should add a hard gate: documented rollback plan and zero data-loss guarantee for Private customers before GA.

olivia (Infra): Also require KMS residency proof-of-concept before Q4 pilot for regulated customers.

maria (PM): OK action items: 1) Sam: RFC on policy model by Tue. 2) Vivek: router hot-reload PR + telemetry tags by Fri. 3) Olivia: KMS integration checklist + POC plan by next Wed. 4) Nina: pilot dashboards and alert thresholds by next Wed.

vivek (Eng): I'll post PR link when ready.

sam (Arch): I'll start the RFC doc, will include example policy-to-routing mapping and migration notes.

olivia (Infra): I'll slot KMS POC with security team — pinging @security.

deploy-bot: Created RFC-1728 in docs/rfc (sam).

maria (PM): Thanks all. If we can hit these artifacts this sprint we can present a clear customer-facing plan. :thumbsup:
